entries.title: Bro Ball kicks off
entries.text: Two teams of two take the pitch at Rumble Stadium.
details: Bump the ball to deflect it, time an attack to kick it, or aim and release to place your shot. A dash into the ball turns it into a Super Kick.
Score five goals to win. If the clock runs out with the score tied, the next goal decides the match.

entries.title: Tighter online combat
entries.text: Shots and moving opponents line up more closely during online matches.
details: Online battles now send position updates 60 times a second, so there is less time between the positions you see.
Enemy projectiles ease forward to catch up with the action. Hit checks also look back a shorter distance in time when resolving an attack.

entries.title: Meet Ozzy and Sparrow
entries.text: Two familiar fighters took new names on the roster.
details: Look for Ozzy when picking the staff-wielding Wizard, and Sparrow for the bow-wielding Huntress.
The same update revised how fighters slide along walls and added a new countdown before the action starts.

entries.title: Mobile controls and battle feedback
entries.text: Touch controls, respawns, and friend activity got an update.
details: Respawning now comes with visual effects and a sound cue to mark your return to the fight.
The friends panel gained last-seen information alongside new privacy settings.

entries.title: More player cards
entries.text: New animated frames arrived for player cards.
details: Arena Crown frames your card in gold and blue gems. Slime Circuit uses green circuitry, and Shuriken Strike pairs crossed swords with a silver throwing star.
Equip a frame to change how your fighter appears on your player card.

entries.title: Candy Land on the move
entries.text: Moving platforms changed how fighters cross Candy Land.
details: Time your jump as a platform approaches, then ride it across the gap. The arena scenery gained layers of candy peaks, clouds, and frosted platforms.
The battle view expanded to fill the window, giving the arena more room on screen.

entries.title: Skins for Ninja and Gloop
entries.text: Ninja and Gloop gained new looks in the skin selector.
details: Arena Sovereign gives Ninja a jeweled crown and a red cape. Gloop’s Crystal skin replaces its slime silhouette with a cluster of blue and violet crystals.
Open the fighter’s skin selector to preview a look and equip one you own.

entries.title: Bots join the battle
entries.text: Bots joined matches and could fill slots in a party.
details: Party controls let players manage bots, and bots gained team support so they could fight alongside human teammates.
A battle log arrived alongside bots so players could revisit their recent matches.
